text:
anya: Quick heads-up: one of the changes landing in SDK 0.18.0 is a canonical routing fallback header `x-rd-fallback`. This is to make server-initiated fallbacks explicit to clients and improve telemetry. Need to sync on compatibility, console metrics, and the rollout UX.

mike: do we have the exact header shape? breaking for on-prem if clients choke on unknown headers. :eyes:

anya: header will be simple kv-ish string for now: `region=eu-west;policy=cost;reason=capacity` — server sets it when it routes away from preferred route. clients should treat it as advisory unless they opt into strict routing.

sam: example for clients?

anya: yep, quick snippet:
```
# python pseudo
headers = {
  "Authorization": "Bearer $TOKEN",
  "x-rd-route": "fast-gpu-us",
  "x-rd-route-version": "v2"
}
# server may respond with
# x-rd-fallback: region=eu-west;policy=cost;reason=capacity
```

jo: I think defaulting to advisory is the right move. On-prem customers who want strict behavior can set `rd-client-route-strict=true` in client configs. That avoids breaking behavior.

mike: ok good. still need to coordinate SDK releases though — python, ts, go should all add parsing helpers and a stable enum for policy values. I can handle go.

katie: console work: we'll need new telemetry tiles in Console -> Routes to show `route_fallback.count` and `route_fallback.latency_p95` broken down by original route and fallback route. Also a small banner in rollout UX to show % traffic hitting server fallbacks.

oscar: telemetry sampling note: our current SDK sampling strips unknown headers for privacy; we need to ensure fallback header isn't dropped. Also add a tag `sdk.routing.header_version` so old clients can be filtered out.

sam: regarding rollout: recommend we do a 2-week opt-in beta. Add a server-side flag `enable_canonical_fallback_v1` that logs fallback but doesn't advertise header until clients are ready.

anya: plan sounds good. action items: (1) mike/oscar: add parsing helpers in go/ts/python and emit `sdk.routing.header_version=1`. (2) jo: add feature flag on server to gate advertising header. (3) katie: console tiles + rollout banner draft. (4) sam: migration playbook for on-prem customers. I'll draft changelog blurb and compatibility note.

mike: I'll start PR for go and a small readme for on-prem.

oscar: will update telemetry ingestion to accept `x-rd-fallback` and map to metrics. Need schema change in metrics pipeline — tagging you @anya for telemetry alert thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/telemetry-ingest v3 -> staging (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

katie: volunteer to write the console mockups this week.

anya: thanks all — can we reconvene Thursday 11am to validate SDK PRs and console mock? :thumbsup:

jo: +1

mike: +1

sam: +1

katie: +1

oscar: +1

anya: I'll also add a short example to the Python and TS quickstart showing how to read `x-rd-fallback` and the opt-in strict flag.

mike: one last ask: add an integration test that simulates server fallback so client SDKs don't regress.

anya: noted, will add to checklist.
